text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Open Sans', 'Noto Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #6b7078

g.text: paired runs per formula. Bands span the 10th to 90th percentile of runs, lines the median. ACP-285's ramp starts early,

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Open Sans', 'Noto Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #6b7078

g.text: toward a 7.5% minimum consumption rate that pays a 48-hour stake about 4.1% of stake a year. Simulated supply adds the

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Open Sans', 'Noto Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #6b7078

g.text: model's validator issuance, less the mean daily burn of the year before, to the total supply of 18 November 2025.
